title: Concept: Rust panic message with source location disclosed in a response
description: A response carries a Rust panic banner with a source location. Panic output names the internal module and the file:line of the failing branch, and Rust services frequently forward the raw error to the client while the same text is also written to logs.
applicability: Rust HTTP services that render panic output.
risk: Internal module layout and failing branch disclosed; MEDIUM severity.
